usage: volume or book, a formal word for 本 (第一册 = volume one).
exampleEn: This dictionary set has three volumes.

usage: for long thin objects: pens, candles and guns (一支笔, 一支蜡烛).
exampleEn: I borrowed a pen.

usage: for flowers, clouds and mushrooms (一朵花, 一朵云).
exampleEn: This flower has bloomed beautifully.

usage: for aircraft, pianos and large machines (一架飞机, 一架钢琴).
exampleEn: An airplane flew across the sky.

usage: for long thin things: ropes, sticks, strands of hair and bananas (一根绳子, 一根香蕉).
exampleEn: I have a white hair on my head.

usage: for walls (一堵墙).
exampleEn: There is a tall wall in the yard.

usage: for schools, hospitals and houses (一所学校, 一所医院).
exampleEn: There is a primary school in the village.

usage: for flat objects with a surface: mirrors, walls, flags and drums (一面镜子, 一面旗).
exampleEn: A mirror hangs on the wall.

usage: for small round objects: stars, teeth, pieces of candy and pearls (一颗星星, 一颗糖).
example: 天上有一颗最亮的星星。
exampleEn: There is one brightest star in the sky.

usage: for steps and levels (三级台阶, 第一级); also 一级一级 = step by step.
exampleEn: There are three steps at the entrance.

usage: for sums of money and transactions (一笔钱, 一笔生意, 一笔账).
exampleEn: He borrowed a sum of money from me.

usage: for TV episodes (一集电视剧, 最后一集).
exampleEn: This TV series has forty episodes.

usage: for orders and deals in business or delivery (一单生意, 一单外卖).
example: 他今天接了一单大生意。
exampleEn: He landed a big deal today.

usage: for horses and bolts of cloth (一匹马, 一匹布).
exampleEn: He came riding a horse.

usage: for items that come as a matching set or pair: glasses, gloves and playing cards (一副眼镜).
exampleEn: He is wearing a pair of glasses.

usage: a bunch or bundle of long things tied together (一束花, 一束阳光).
exampleEn: He gave me a bunch of roses.

usage: a lump, ball or mass of something soft (一团毛线, 一团棉花, 一团火).
exampleEn: The kitten is playing with a ball of yarn.

usage: a pile or heap of (一堆书, 一堆垃圾, 一堆雪).
exampleEn: A pile of books sits on the desk.

usage: a set or suite of things that go together (一套房子, 一套衣服, 一套邮票).
exampleEn: He bought a new apartment.

usage: a batch, shipment or group arriving together (一批货, 第一批).
exampleEn: The shop has received a new batch of goods.

usage: a group, team or set formed for a purpose (一组照片, 第一组).
exampleEn: We split into two groups.

usage: a group, herd or flock of people or animals (一群人, 一群羊, 一群鸟).
exampleEn: There is a flock of sheep on the grass.

usage: a row or line of text or objects (一行字, 第二行).
exampleEn: Please read the second line.

usage: a team or orderly group of people (一队人, 排成一队).
exampleEn: Everyone queued up in one line to buy tickets.

usage: for sessions, terms and graduating cohorts (这届学生, 上届奥运会).
exampleEn: This cohort of students is all very hardworking.

usage: kind or category, a formal word similar to 种 (这类问题).
exampleEn: I do not like this kind of movie.

usage: centimeter (五厘米 = five centimeters).
exampleEn: This book is three centimeters thick.

usage: ton (一吨 = 1000 kilograms).
exampleEn: This truck can carry three tons of goods.

usage: degrees: for temperature (三十度) and angles (九十度).
exampleEn: It is 35 degrees today.

usage: for scheduled runs of transport (这班飞机, 下一班车).
example: 我赶上了最后一班地铁。
exampleEn: I caught the last subway train.

usage: a glance or look, after verbs (看一眼, 看了两眼).
example: 她看了我一眼，没有说话。
exampleEn: She glanced at me and said nothing.

usage: for incidents, accidents and cases (一起事故, 一起火灾).
example: 昨天发生了一起交通事故。
exampleEn: A traffic accident happened yesterday.

usage: a short burst or spell of weather or sound (一阵风, 一阵掌声).
exampleEn: A gust of wind suddenly blew in.

usage: a basin or pot of (一盆水); also for potted plants (一盆花).
exampleEn: A potted flower sits on the balcony.

usage: a pot or wok of cooked food (一锅汤, 一锅米饭).
exampleEn: Mom cooked a pot of soup.
